env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Currently, we only evaluate Meta Agent Search on single-step QA tasks in this paper.
env_context_strategy.note: The task text and the domain description in the prompt are the only context. There is no repository or environment navigation.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Make sure to return in a WELL-FORMED JSON object.

tool_count.note: There are no function-calling tools. Framework helpers such as LLMAgentBase and run_examples_and_get_feedback are available to the generated code.
